plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.258-259.

courses.title: Career / Internship / Directed Study course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 2 credits as printed: CLD 3100 Experiencing Career and Life Directions; HIS/POL 3800 Internship; POL 3900 Directed Study.

courses.title: Revolution / Nations / Middle East / Political Science course (choose two)
courses.choice_note: Choose two of these courses, 8 credits as printed: HPS 3120 Revolution; HPS 3360 Nations and Nationalism; HPS 3380 Middle East History, Politics, and Thought; POL 2100 Feminist and Queer Studies; POL 3110 Race and Identity; POL 3350 War and Conflict; POL 4510 Special Topics in Political Science.

courses.title: Civil War / Judicial Process / Constitutional Law / Administration course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: HPS 3320 Civil War and Reconstruction; LGA/POL 2210 Judicial Process; LGA/POL 4200 Constitutional Law; POL 3250 Public and Non-Profit Administration.

courses.title: Methods of Critical Inquiry / Research Methods course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: HPS 3910 Methods of Critical Inquiry; SSC 3600 Research Methods in the Social Sciences.

courses.title: ART, DAN, ECM, HIS, HPS, MUS, or THE 2000+ courses (Required Related)
courses.choice_note: Required Related Courses for the B.A. degree: ART, DAN, ECM, HIS, HPS, MUS, or THE 2000+ courses, 4 credits as printed.
